headline: Oil Rose 1.11 Percent to 94.78
narrative: Oil rose 1.11 percent to 94.78, money moving into the energy pipe. Silver fell 1.09 percent to 59.49 and gold eased 0.09 percent to 4186.9, the precious metals pipe giving ground, while copper rose 1.06 percent to 6.77. Bitcoin held near 84k, with seven-day realized volatility at 20.1 against a 30-day reading of 48.89.
